title: A review in radiomics: Making personalized medicine a reality via routine imaging

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A review in radiomics: Making personalized medicine a reality via routine imaging》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】For these reasons the present review aims to be a guidebook of sorts, describing the process of radiomics, its pitfalls, challenges, and opportunities, along with its ability to improve clinical decision-making, from oncology and respiratory medicine to pharmacological and genotyping studies.
